blocking.issue: The Open-question gates are wrong or incomplete, so M3 and M4 could exit with a blocking decision still open. At M2, 45 Open questions currently have a Blocking column that names M2, not 41. The M3 list leaves out OQ-deployment-topologies-13: `ruralz/v1beta1`, listed in M3 scope, needs a CRD conversion webhook port that pack 8.4 lacks, so shipping it needs a pack amendment. The M4 list leaves out OQ-deployment-topologies-17, which decides how Nodes behave when every relay in their Region is lost, and the relay is an M4 scope item. verify-docs also WARNs that 'OQ-deployment-topologies-13' is Planned (M3) but has no item under M3.

Deployment topologies: "| OQ-deployment-topologies-13 | Which port serves the CRD conversion webhook, absent from pack 8.4? | ... | Yes, before `ruralz.io/v1beta1`, Planned (M3) |". M4 criterion 4 lists OQ-wasm-plugin-system-8 and -17 ... OQ-performance-budgets-and-benchmarking-7, but not "| OQ-deployment-topologies-17 | What do Nodes do when every relay in their Region is lost? | ... | Yes, for Planned (M4) |".
